titulo: Common carp relatives blunt koi herpesvirus infections, offering clues to outbreak control
cuerpo: Common carp are among the world's most widely farmed freshwater fish, providing food and livelihoods for millions of people. But across fish farms and freshwater ecosystems, they face a formidable threat: a highly contagious virus capable of causing devastating outbreaks and wiping out entire populations in a matter of days.
